title: Hung Physical Diagnostic Probe Postmortem
exact_command: .venv\Scripts\python -c "import subprocess, time, ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wintypes; NPP = r'C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe'; p = subprocess.Popen([NPP, '-nosession', '-multiInst']); time.sleep(1.8); user32 = ctypes.windll.user32; hwnds = []; def _cb2(h, _): cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256); user32.GetClassNameW(h, cbuf:=cls, 256); wpid = wintypes.DWORD(); user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, ctypes.byref(wpid)); if wpid.value == p.pid and cls.value == 'Notepad++': hwnds.append(h); return True; user32.EnumWindows(ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM)(_cb2), 0); main_hwnd = hwnds[0]; scis = []; def _cb3(ch, _): cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256); user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 256); if 'scintilla' in cls.value.lower() and user32.IsWindowVisible(ch): scis.append(ch); return True; user32.EnumChildWindows(main_hwnd, ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM)(_cb3), 0); sci = scis[0]; for c in 'hello world': user32.SendMessageW(sci, 0x0102, ord(c), 0); time.sleep(0.2); for cid in [42020, 42021, 42022, 42023, 42024, 42025, 42031]: user32.SendMessageW(main_hwnd, 0x0111, cid, 0); s = user32.SendMessageW(sci, 2143, 0, 0); e = user32.SendMessageW(sci, 2145, 0, 0); if s == 0 and e == 11: print('SUCCESS with ID:', cid); break; p.kill()"
last_successful_operation: Dispatched text 'hello world' to child Scintilla control via SendMessageW(0x0102)
operation_at_which_progress_stopped: Synchronous user32.SendMessageW(main_hwnd, 0x0111, 42020, 0) blocking indefinitely on Win32 window procedure message loop

root_cause_analysis.primary_mechanism: Synchronous SendMessageW dispatch of untested WM_COMMAND identifier caused Notepad++ window procedure to block (or open modal sub-loop), stalling caller indefinitely.
root_cause_analysis.architectural_defect: Absence of bounded timeout watchdog, lack of unbuffered I/O (flush=True), and executing unbounded multi-line inline python command ('python -c') without try/finally resource guard.
